content.title: When Does the Next Episode of 'Shrinking' Come Out? Release Schedule, Episode Count and More
content.text: Key PointsShrinking returns for Season 3 as appointment viewing on Apple TV+, featuring an all-star cast led by Jason Segel, Harrison Ford, Jessica Williams, Brett Goldstein, and new addition Michael J. Fox.The season premiered January 28, 2026, with new episodes dropping weekly on Wednesdays at 12 p.m. PT, for a total of 11 episodes running through April 8.Season 3 focuses on the fallout from Jimmy’s rule-breaking therapy approach, shifting the story from breakthroughs to consequences as his honesty reshapes — and strains — every relationship in his life. Many consider Shrinking appointment viewing, especially now that the show has returned for Season 3. The show boasts an impressive lineup of talent in front of and behind the camera. Created by Bill Lawrence (Ted Lasso, Scrubs) and starring Jason Segel, Harrison Ford, Brett Goldstein and Jessica Williams, the show has added even more star power with its new episodes by adding Michael J. Fox to the cast. Keep reading for the episode release schedule and everything else you need to know about how to watch Shrinking Season 3. 🎬SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 When did Shrinking Season 3 premiere? The show had its Season 3 premiere on Jan. 28, 2026. Related: ‘Shrinking’: How Michael J. Fox Avoided Play Himself on the Show When do new episodes of Shrinking Season 3 premiere? New episodes of the show premiere each Wednesday at 12 p.m. PT. How many episodes of Shrinking Season 3 will there be? There will be 11 episodes in total in Season 3 of Shrinking. Related: ‘Shrinking’ Season 3 Sneak Peek: Is Derek ‘Revenge Cheating’ on Liz? (Exclusive) What is the release schedule of Shrinking Season 3? The release schedule is as follows: Episode 6 — Wednesday, Mar. 4 Episode 7 — Wednesday, Mar. 11 Episode 8 — Wednesday, Mar. 18 Episode 9 — Wednesday, Mar. 25 Episode 10 — Wednesday, Apr. 1 Episode 11 — Wednesday, Apr. 8 Where to watch Shrinking The show is available to watch on Apple TV. What is Shrinking Season 3 about? Season 3 of Shrinking continues to follow Jimmy (Jason Segel), a grieving therapist who breaks with traditional ethics and starts telling his clients exactly what he thinks, only now the show turns its focus to the fallout of those choices. As his radical honesty continues to ripple through the lives of his patients, friends, and family, Jimmy is forced to confront how much damage can hide inside good intentions — and whether real growth means fixing people or learning to live with the mess you’ve already made.
